description: Single source of truth for the Emscripten toolchain pin and compile/link flags. Consumed by wasm_renderer/build.sh (via scripts/format-wasm-compile-flags.js; the only build), scripts/emcc-version-gate.sh and the CI wasm job (setup-emsdk version must equal emsdkVersion). Export lists live in wasm_exports.json. Two release artifacts are built from the same sources: the top-level graph (sFlags, jsOutputName) is the ASYNCIFY fallback and keeps today's ABI; the `jspi` graph swaps ASYNCIFY for JSPI and is loaded only where WebAssembly.Suspending exists (src/wasm/bridge/init.ts). Never ship JSPI-only (asyncifyFallback). WaitAny init needs one of the two — see wasm_renderer/BUILD_FLAG_EXPERIMENTS.md before touching either. GROWABLE_ARRAYBUFFERS=0 is deliberate (TextDecoder + resizable heap); do not flip without a Dawn re-test. extraFlags are plain em++ args (compile + link); -flto adopted 2026-10 (-12.5 KB .wasm); -fno-rtti adopted 2026-10-18 (-189 B, and a tripwire against typeid/dynamic_cast). Debug / ASan builds are `profiles` (WASM_PROFILE) and stay ASYNCIFY-only; they are never copied to public/wasm/. `sources` is the one translation-unit list (build.sh and `npm run wasm:compdb` both read it).

debug.description: Local debugging build (`npm run wasm:build:debug`). -O0 + DWARF + a source map so Chrome DevTools steps through the C++; ASSERTIONS=2 and SAFE_HEAP=1 trap bad heap access with a stack instead of corrupting silently. -flto is dropped (slow link, no debug value at -O0). ASYNCIFY only (no JSPI twin). The output goes to wasm_renderer/build/debug/ and is never copied to public/wasm/: the committed artifacts are always the release builds. `asan` is opt-in on top (WASM_ASAN=1) and drops SAFE_HEAP, which ASan refuses to link with.

jspi.description: JSPI primary graph. sFlags must equal the fallback sFlags with ASYNCIFY replaced by JSPI (verify:wasm-invariants). jspiExports lists every C export whose call graph can reach wgpuInstanceWaitAny; each becomes Promise-returning and the bridge must ccall it with { async: true } via src/wasm/bridge/call.ts SUSPENDING_EXPORTS. Calling an unlisted export that suspends traps under JSPI. extraFlags and profiles apply on top of these sFlags the same way they apply to the fallback.

waitAnyCallGraph.initWasmRenderer: Initialize → CreateDevice (adapter, device, format-probe error scope WaitAny) → CreateResources → CreateHistoryTextureFailSoft → TryCreateHistoryTexture (error scope WaitAny)
